SELECT t1.`tenant` FROM `emergency_rule` t1 INNER JOIN `emergency_rule_condition_group` erc ON t1.`id` = erc.`emergency_rule_id` INNER JOIN `emergency_rule_condition` t2 ON t1.`id` = t2.`emergency_rule_id` INNER JOIN `emergency_rule_condition_device` t3 ON t1.`id` = t3.`emergency_rule_id`
WHERE t2.`device_event_code` = #{eventCode} AND t3.`device_id` = #{deviceId} GROUP BY t1.`tenant`
